cornerstone.notes: exists=false confirmed. The only 'cornerstone' hits in the 456-page text are figurative ('TCM is a cornerstone of Hong Kong's healthcare culture', p.73) and generic free-float boilerplate ('all Shares to be issued to the cornerstone investors (if any)', p.109). There is no cornerstone placing section and no cornerstone lock-up clause.

controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p.285: Rule 10.07 undertaking, paragraph (i) 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “Relevant Period”)'. Inclusive explicit end -> last_restricted_day=2026-12-05, first_free_day=2026-12-06 (listing 2026-06-05). Correct.
